tools.name: get_permit

tools.name: recent_permits
tools.description: Use when someone asks what is being built in their neighborhood or ZIP code. Returns the newest building permits in a supported city or county, optionally within one ZIP code.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "permits_at_address" is 912 chars, far longer than this server's median (175). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
